content.text:
The bug was in `src/offset.js`. It computed `page * perPage`, which treats pages as 0-indexed, but the tests and `pageOf` use 1-indexed pages. Page 1 therefore skipped the first five issues, and page 3 started past the end of the list.

I changed it to `(page - 1) * perPage`. All 4 tests now pass. `offset` is only used by `pageOf`, so nothing else is affected.
